images.prompt: Flat vector brand logo, engraved vintage seal styling. A circular cream seal ring containing a stylized siren figure whose face has been replaced by the silhouette of a fuel dispensing nozzle, rendered in cream line-engraving on a deep forest green field. Fine cream double-ring border and radiating engraved linework inside the ring. Full-bleed square: the background colour fills the entire canvas edge to edge. No card, no frame, no rounded container, no drop shadow, no surrounding margin or border. The only text anywhere in the image is exactly: STARBUX. Set that one word in clean cream sans-serif capitals inside the upper arc of the seal ring, correctly spelled, letters evenly spaced. Crisp vector edges, no photographic texture, no extra words, no symbols.

Cinematic wide interior architectural photograph of a cavernous coffee refueling terminal. Long polished white marble counters run the length of the hall. Rows of industrial brass fuel-pump-style dispensing hoses hang from retractable overhead reels, brass pressure gauges and valve wheels mounted on a deep forest green tiled wall behind. A stanchion-and-rope queue maze snakes across the floor with nobody in it. Tall arched windows pour warm morning light across polished terrazzo, faint steam drifting near the ceiling, dust motes in the light beams. Soft north-facing window light with a warm amber bounce, gentle contrast, premium lifestyle photography. Camera: 24mm, f/5.6, deep focus, subtle vignette. Deadpan hyperreal architectural realism, completely deserted. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.
